reviewed_by: Claude review of the chat-reconnection readiness gate
reason: Both chat-reconnection tests have been failing on origin/main at every one of the six phone widths the reconnection config runs. After pairing, the spec waited for the desktop connection chip (a button labelled 'Nebula Core ready|degraded'), but the phone shell added by #355 hides that chip when Core is ready and hides the whole top bar on workbench routes, so the locator can never become visible at 320, 390 or 430 pixels. The gate only needs to know that pairing finished before the test navigates, so it now waits for the pairing form to close, which every width renders, and the following hydration assertion carries the 20 second budget the gate used to provide. Reproduced on pristine main (element not found after 20s) and verified fixed here.
exclusions: No python tests: no src/nebula change. No frontend tests: no ui/src change, so no vitest file is affected. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. Playwright is limited to area:chat-reconnection because only that area's spec file changes; no other area reads it.
